_doc: Ordered path rules mapping every fork file to one cluster. First match wins. The list order is also the commit order of the restacked stack (one commit per cluster). Paths include the LLVM 19+ locations (TargetParser, SemaRISCV, BuiltinsRISCV.td) so the map keeps working after the relocations.
